name: Zola Mbeki
bio: Zola is a self-made entrepreneur in the tech sector, having built a successful cybersecurity firm from the ground up. Her drive and independence are her defining characteristics, though she admits commitment is a challenge for her. She enjoys the freedom her success has afforded her and is looking for someone who appreciates her lifestyle without trying to change it. While she enjoys meeting new people, she values quality time above all else and seeks a partner who is present and engaged when they are together.

physical.hairStyle: Long, thick braids often styled in an updo
physical.description: Zola possesses a strong, athletic build and a radiant smile. Her sharp features are softened by her warm, expressive eyes, often framed by stylish glasses.

meetingContext: At a tech conference where the player's racing team is showcasing its data analytics capabilities.
firstImpression: She commands attention with her confident demeanor and striking attire, sporting a vibrant Ankara print dress that reflects her heritage.
loveLanguage: Quality Time: She appreciates undivided attention, meaningful conversations, and shared experiences.
